title: Cross-Member Session Isolation Failure
description:
Vulnerabilities related to inadequate isolation between team members sharing a workspace.

Vulnerabilities to fix:

1. [High] Any team member can list and revoke other members' active sessions

title: Store Content TOCTOU Authorization Gap
description:
Vulnerabilities related to non-atomic authorization checks in content store write paths.

Vulnerabilities to fix:

1. [Medium] Non-atomic ownership check on archive and planner write operations
  The archive and planner endpoints that delete or soft-delete content items check ownership before executing the write, but the write query itself is not scoped to the authorised owner set.
